answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
